_note: Narration for the Terkini demo video. Every number comes from eval/my/results.json (21 Nov 2026) or a recorded run in docs/cases/. Voice: AI clone of the builder's own voice, labelled on the end card.

baris.sari: Ask an AI about a Malaysian rule, and it answers with confidence. Sometimes the rule changed years ago.
We asked 3 models 23 questions. 28 of 68 answers stated a rule that is no longer current.
baris.baca: We asked three models, twenty-three questions. Twenty-eight of sixty-eight answers, stated a rule that is no longer current.

baris.sari: Terkini checks those answers against official government pages.
Each claim goes to Tavily Search, restricted to official domains, with live results for rules that change. Then Tavily Extract reads the page itself.
baris.baca: Each claim goes to Tavvily Search, restricted to official domains, with live results for rules that change. Then, Tavvily Extract reads the page itself.

baris.sari: Here the answer says 6%. The customs page says 8%, from March 2024. Outdated.
baris.baca: Here, the answer says six percent. The customs page says eight percent, from March twenty twenty-four. Outdated.

baris.sari: Every verdict must quote the page word for word. Terkini then checks that the quote is really there. No exact quote, no verdict.
baris.baca: Every verdict must quote the page, word for word. Terkini then checks that the quote is really there. No exact quote, no verdict.

baris.sari: The models run through Bifrost: one virtual key, a daily budget, and fallbacks across vendors.
baris.baca: The models run through Bifrost: one virtual key, a daily budget, and fallbacks across vendors.

baris.sari: Terkini flagged 17 answers, and 10 were really stale. That is 59% precision and 36% recall. The misses are published too.
